The B/L and IGM must agree with the packing list. A short or excess package count, or a gross weight that does not match, is one of the most common reasons for a hold or an amendment fee.
The consignee on the B/L, the buyer on the invoice and the IEC and GSTIN must line up with the Bill of Entry or Shipping Bill. A spelling difference can delay the delivery order.
Container numbers carry a check digit (ISO 6346). A typo is caught instantly, and seal numbers must match what is on the container at the gate.
FOB or FCA usually means freight collect, CFR or CIF freight prepaid. When they disagree, confirm who pays: it also changes the value customs assesses duty on.
No. The checker runs entirely in your browser. Your invoice, packing list, B/L and AWB are read on your own device and are never sent to YAM or stored anywhere. Close the page and they are gone.

Shipper and consignee names, gross and net weights, number of packages, container and seal numbers, HS codes, IEC and GSTIN, the invoice number, ports of loading and discharge, the Incoterm against the freight terms, container check digits and, for air, the AWB check digit, pieces and chargeable weight.

Customs and shipping lines compare these documents. A different weight, package count or consignee name can lead to a hold, an examination, an IGM, B/L or AWB amendment fee, or a delay in getting the delivery order.
It misread a value. What now?
Click the value in the results table and type the correct one; the check updates immediately. Text PDFs are read most accurately; scans and phone photos are read with OCR and can contain errors.
Does it replace my customs broker?
No. It is a quick first check. Your customs broker should still review the documents before filing. If you want YAM to review them, message us on WhatsApp.

Piece counts differ. The pieces on the AWB and IGM must match the packing list, or the shipment can be held as short or excess landed.
Chargeable weight on the AWB (498 kg) is higher than the gross weight (412 kg): the cargo is billed on volume weight. Check the carton dimensions if this looks high.
